verdict.rationale: Notte has first-party integration guides for CrewAI and the Vercel AI SDK, both of which connect through the official Notte MCP server. It also has guides for Claude Code and Claude managed agents that use the Notte CLI, plus one for OpenAI CUA. These are documented integration paths rather than native framework adapters, and no LangChain guide appears in the evidence. missing for 10: LangChain integration, explicit Claude Agent SDK adapter, native (non-MCP/CLI) framework adapters, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can plug the browser layer into agent frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, CrewAI) through documented adapters

citations.quote: pointing it at the Notte MCP server hands your crew a real browser.
Point its MCP client at the Notte MCP server and your TypeScript agent gets a browser.
give them the notte CLI and they can drive real browsers
This guide explains how to integrate OpenAI's Computer Use Agent (CUA) with Notte's browser infrastructure for automated web interactions.
